name: decamelize-separator-positional-to-options-yargs-unparser
behavioral_change: decamelize 5.0.0 moved `separator` from the second positional argument to a field of an options object: the signature changed from `(text, separator = '_')` to `(text, {separator = '_', preserveConsecutiveUppercase = false} = {})`. The v_old call `decamelize(key, '-')` still runs in v_new, but the string `'-'` is destructured as an options object, `separator` falls back to `'_'`, and no error or warning is raised.
downstream_effect: In the downstream project (yargs-unparser), `isCamelCased` uses `decamelize(key, '-')` to rebuild the dash form of a key and check it against argv; after the upgrade it produces `some_string` instead, the check always fails, and `unparse` emits an extra `--someString foo`. The two failures are jest `toEqual` mismatches reported at `test/index.spec.js:74` and `:86` with no frame in `index.js`, and the output never mentions decamelize or separator.
reference_fix: The reference fix changes one line in `index.js` (line 19), replacing `argv[decamelize(key, '-')]` with `argv[decamelize(key, { separator: '-' })]`.
documented_in: The v5.0.0 release notes at https://github.com/sindresorhus/decamelize/releases/tag/v5.0.0 state under Breaking that the `separator` argument moved to the options object and show a diff (`-decamelize('unicornRainbow', '-');` / `+decamelize('unicornRainbow', {separator: '-'});`); the README API section documents the new `decamelize(input, options?)` signature. Tier 1: the documentation shows the new code form.
failing_tests: test/index.spec.js :: should not duplicate keys that are camel-cased
test/index.spec.js :: should not duplicate nested keys that are camel-cased
